item.tib: gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo'i gsal byed
item.skt: ya mA ri kriSh+Na tsakra ud t+ya ta
item.coloph: 'khor lo'i tshogs gsal bar byed pa'i/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa/ bsod snyoms pa bud d+ha shrI dz+nyA nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi paN+Di ta di paM kA ra shrI dz+nyA na dang / lo tsA ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur bas las/ dus phyis dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bcos pa'o
